  WHY: A final CI run cancelled by hand after all its needed jobs have started still posts ci/final=failure over an earlier success, which defeats the issue's Goal; runs with more than 10 started cancelled jobs fall into "unverified" and also post failure (fails closed; MAJOR).

  WHY: The worst case of one jobs GET plus up to 10 annotation GETs at a 30 s subprocess timeout each can pass 90 s, and the timeout is then indistinguishable in the logs (NIT); sonnet and glm raised the same point only as HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS.

- requirement: "A run that was cancelled as a whole posts no `ci/final` status." (issue #10131 Goal; the design reads jobs with filter=latest, not only attempt 1)
  expected_change_site: scripts/ci_final_status.sh:ci_final_status_run_was_cancelled (GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT gate, lines 104-106) and scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py:list_run_jobs (attempts/1 endpoint, line 399)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/ci_final_status.sh:104-106 logs `verdict=not_attempt_1` and posts failure for any attempt other than 1, scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py:399 hardcodes `/attempts/1/jobs` instead of filter=latest, tests/test_ci_final_status.py:442-447 (test_later_attempt_posts_failure_without_jobs_read) locks in failure for attempt 2, so a wholly cancelled re-run (the sweep's attempt 2 or a ci-final-pr-<n> concurrency replacement) still posts a false ci/final=failure that can overwrite an earlier success, and although the README, changelog and fragment document the limit, the issue does not defer it and the PR description records no deliberate deviation.
- requirement: "otherwise read the run's jobs once (GET repos/<repo>/actions/runs/<run_id>/jobs?per_page=100&filter=latest, through gh_retry)" (issue #10131, Design step 1)
  expected_change_site: scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py:list_run_jobs (lines 396-402), called by classify_cancelled_run at line 577
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: list_run_jobs (scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py:396-402) calls `gh api` once through subprocess.run with `timeout=30` and no gh_retry or retry, so a transient 5xx or connection error raises ValueError("jobs_unreadable"), classify_cancelled_run returns "unverified", and the status script posts ci/final=failure; this PR adds a second caller whose contract the issue tied to gh_retry.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py:lines 560-572, the docstring of classify_cancelled_run. Each continuation line (561, 564, 565, 566, 567, 569, 570, 571, 572) starts with a tab and then two spaces | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Indentation mixes tabs and spaces, and ruff reports E101 nine times ("E101 Indentation contains mixed spaces and tabs --> scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py:561:1" ... "Found 9 errors."). The reviewer confirmed that lines 561-572 match ^\t +\S.
  WHY: static-checks exits 1, and because static-checks is in lint.needs, `lint`, CI / lint and ci/final all go red. Fix: indent the continuation lines with tabs only.
- scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py:in classify_cancelled_run, the line `if not shutdown_only_annotations(failure_annotations(repo, check_run_id)): return "not_cancelled"`. tests/test_ci_cancelled_rerun.py line 1297 makes [annotation("The run was canceled by @someone.")] a case that must give "not_cancelled". | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When every cancelled needed job has started, the skip is allowed only if the annotations are limited to the runner-shutdown text or "The operation was canceled.", so the "The run was canceled by @<user>." annotation left by a hand cancel disqualifies the skip.
  WHY: A run cancelled by hand after all its needed jobs have started still posts ci/final=failure over an earlier success, and more than 10 started cancelled jobs gives "unverified"; it fails closed. Fix: accept the run-level cancel annotation and keep the timeout annotation as the disqualifier.
- agents.d/10131-final-ci-status-cancelled-run.md:line 6, "LOG_PREFIX.name=CI_FINAL_STATUS" | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: agents.d/9939-final-ci-status-gate.md line 10 already registers it, and scripts/assemble_agents.py (REGISTRY_NAME, line 102) appends name lines without deduplicating.
  WHY: The folded registry gets two identical CI_FINAL_STATUS name lines. Fix: delete line 6.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "otherwise read the run's jobs once (GET repos/<repo>/actions/runs/<run_id>/jobs?per_page=100&filter=latest, through gh_retry)", in support of "A run that was cancelled as a whole posts no ci/final status."
  Expected change site: ci_final_status_run_was_cancelled in scripts/ci_final_status.sh (lines 104-106), and the jobs read that classify_cancelled_run makes through list_run_jobs in scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py (lines 396-402).
  Evidence of absence: The code reads only repos/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/attempts/1/jobs through subprocess.run, with no gh_retry or retry. A non-1 attempt logs verdict=not_attempt_1 and posts failure, which test_later_attempt_posts_failure_without_jobs_read locks in. A single transient read error also posts failure. Both fail closed and the limit is documented, but it is not recorded in the PR description as a deliberate departure.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING (risk score 1): scripts/ci_final_status.sh ci_final_status_run_was_cancelled `timeout 90 python3 ... classify-cancelled-run ... | tail -n 1`. The worst case is about 330 s, which is more than 90 s, and a timeout silently becomes verdict=none. Fix: capture PIPESTATUS[0] and, when it is 124, add `reason=timeout` or a ::warning:: (about 3 lines).
